record.title: Efficient Online Decision Tree Learning with Active Feature Acquisition
record.reason: Exclude under biomedical-dominant scope: UFODT advances general fully-online decision trees and cost-sensitive feature acquisition. Medical diagnosis motivates the formulation, and SPECT Heart plus the dedicated continuous-feature diabetes/breast-cancer/fetal-health experiments are substantive. However the central stationary study gives equal methodological roles to LED, Zoo, SPECT Heart, COMPAS recidivism and FICO credit risk; a separate Stagger concept-drift study validates another major contribution. Results and conclusion concern general query cost, prediction utility, continuous-feature handling and drift adaptation rather than a predominantly biomedical question. This is co-central mixed-domain research, not a finding of no medical evidence.

Primary question is generic label-distribution correlation and where to impose low rank, motivated with natural-scene labels. Experiments use a heterogeneous benchmark suite and interpret performance through generic divergence metrics, rank tests and generic ablations, not gene expression structure or a biological modeling question. Biological data are valid biology, but their presence is benchmark evidence rather than primary biological direction.

Biomedical graph learning is a primary actual application and experimental direction: the drug substructure-position/activity problem directly motivates the proposed representation, and molecular activity/toxicity, protein/enzyme and brain graph tasks carry both the principal classification validation and substantial component ablations. Social-graph extensions and universal kernel proofs do not make the biomedical work incidental. No disease-specific architecture, wet-lab experiment or new biological discovery is required by the user criterion.

CRC histopathology is a substantive design-motivating application: Introduction/Figure 2 demonstrate the candidate/noncandidate discrimination issue on CRC-MIPL-Row, and Section 4.3 interprets image-bag generator effects through tissue/background discrimination. Conversely, Section 4.4 tests the central CLI components, disambiguation robustness, CLI-versus-cross-entropy mechanism, and attention interpretability on nonmedical benchmarks; these experiments support the primary general weak-supervision claims. This competing evidence prevents calling CRC merely incidental, but does not yet certify the paper as primarily biomedical under the requested threshold.

record.rationale: Primary problem is biomedical specimen integrity detection from longitudinal human urinary steroid-metabolism measurements. Model construction explicitly uses temporal physiology and cross-metabolite dependence, all empirical work uses athlete biochemical profiles, and the case study is checked against laboratory DNA analysis. Sports anti-fraud purpose does not erase the primary biological-sample analytics; disease diagnosis is not required.

Individual brain/biological causal structure under limited per-individual samples is an explicit central problem, not merely a generic algorithm with a biomedical token benchmark. Real-data evaluation interprets specific fMRI input/brain-region edges and cellular protein perturbation edges, with biological graph accuracy against Sachs reference relations. Stock indices demonstrate an additional domain but do not displace the substantive neuroscience/cellular research direction.
